Multi-Modal Metabolite Peak Regulatory Network Inference Module

Source: R/bulkPanel_MultiGRNTab.R
multi_grn_panel.Rd

Performs comparative GRN inference across multiple sample groups using combined bulk and multi-modal data. Enables side-by-side comparison of metabolite peak regulatory relationships across different conditions or sample sets.

Key features: - Multi-network inference (1-4 networks) from independent sample subsets - GENIE3-based GRN construction from combined bulk/multi-modal data - Network visualization with recurring regulators highlighted - Interactive upset plots showing regulator overlap across networks - Customizable connection filtering and network topology visualization

Usage

BulkMultiGRNUI(id, bulk.metadata, show = TRUE)

BulkMultiGRNServer(id, bulk.intensity.matrix, bulk.metadata, anno, multi_modal)

Details

Accepts bulk intensity matrix and multi-modal data, combining them for joint GRN inference. Removes constant features before analysis. Supports flexible sample selection per network and identifies regulatory patterns that are conserved or divergent across conditions.
